old_problem: The source body has doubled quotes, empty If-Match and no authoritative meaning for OEM BIOS attribute value 2; active/pending/apply semantics, expected result, restoration and unbootable recovery are missing.
disposition_reason: Redfish standard supplies the BIOS Settings transaction pattern but not this OEM attribute enumeration or safe value. ED-11 forbids unapproved all/random BIOS changes and ED-15 forbids PASS without an oracle. Core value semantics and boot recovery therefore cannot be parameterized by guesswork.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2256 and 2257, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical record and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve named attribute, literal value 2, GET→PATCH→reboot→GET coverage and malformed Master text as history.
Require the exact BIOS registry enumeration, initial/test/final values, active/pending resources, ETag and apply/reset workflow.
Back up all BIOS settings, PATCH only the named attribute once, diff unrelated settings, verify boot health and restore final state.
Empty If-Match, invalid JSON, grep-only validation, blind reboot and automatic retry are rejected.
No authentication, GET, PATCH, BIOS change, reboot, restoration or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Reversible Redfish BIOS CbsCmnApbdisDfPstate value-2 transaction
test_case.purpose: Stage the exact approved meaning of `CbsCmnApbdisDfPstate=2`, activate it once by reboot, verify active state/health and restore the signed final configuration without unrelated drift.
required_package: BMC/BIOS build and Redfish BIOS registry
Authoritative value-2 meaning and initial/test/final matrix
Active/pending Settings, ETag/If-Match and apply/reboot semantics
Configuration backup, console/BIOS recovery and boot-health oracle
test_case.test_command: Gate closed. After registry and recovery approval, save active/pending JSON and ETag, send one valid attribute-only PATCH using required concurrency control, monitor task/apply status, reboot once, verify active value/health/unrelated diff, then perform and verify the approved restoration including any separately authorized reboot.
test_case.expected_result: The staged value 2 is accepted exactly as defined, becomes active after the approved reboot, causes no unrelated BIOS drift or boot-health failure, and the signed final value is restored and verified.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative value semantics, successful ETag-protected transaction, active post-reboot proof, health/unrelated-diff checks and verified restoration. Unknown value/schema/recovery keeps Pending; HTTP success or grep output alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Independent console and recoverable BIOS backup required.
One named-attribute PATCH and one separately approved activation only.
No empty If-Match, malformed body, guessed enum or unrelated change.
Stop on task, apply, boot, drift or restoration anomaly; no retry.
expected_evidence: Pre active/pending JSON, ETag and full setting backup
Restoration/final value, recovery audit and verdict
test_case.recovery: On rejection, unbootable state or drift, stop and use the pre-approved console/BIOS recovery and configuration backup; preserve Redfish/task/console evidence and never re-PATCH automatically.
